subject: Graffiti
advisory: Mood sizes (ordinary wall art about +2 to +3 capped), weather days and the raider pressure factor are tuning; scenes check the sign and shape, not the exact number

leaves.oracle_proposed: every lane holds at least one RM_Graffiti mark made by its own painter after the spree; control: a lane whose painter is never broken holds none
leaves.tier_reason: marks, thoughts, jobs and letters are runtime state of a running map; the kernel selftest proves only the pure rules
leaves.experience: After a colonist's painting spree ends, the player sees new marks on the wall beside where the colonist painted.
leaves.scenario: Quicktest map, six colonists each with a wall lane, a forced painting spree each, 3000 ticks; count marks in each lane.
false_pass: the job log shows paint jobs and the wall stays empty
marks are spawned by the test, not by the job
leaves.red: a build whose paint job completes and places nothing (the old placementMask Any bug)

leaves.oracle_proposed: a judge reading the 64 px gallery pages calls each cell a deliberate mark; control: a vanilla filth cell on the same page is called dirt

leaves.scenario: Close-up of a painted wall lane after the spree, walls on each side of the painter's cell, and a cell whose only wall is south of it.
false_pass: the mark is drawn on the floor cell beside the wall
